opportunities.name: Dinner plan: restaurant search + recipe search + note
opportunities.description: For a given cuisine/area query and dish, find the top OpenTable restaurant, find the matching Allrecipes recipe, and save a combined dinner note.
steps: Search OpenTable for the cuisine/area query
Open the top restaurant result and read its rating, price, area
Search Allrecipes for the dish and open the top recipe, noting time
Open Notes, click New note and type 'Dinner: out at <restaurant> (<rating>, <price>, <area>) or cook <recipe> (<time>)'

opportunities.name: Stopover hotel: Wikipedia city lookup + Booking search + note
opportunities.description: For a city and a weekend date, look up the city on Wikipedia, search Booking.com for one night, and save a stopover note with the top hotel, price and population.
steps: Search Wikipedia for the city to get population
Enter the city as destination on Booking.com and pick the suggestion
Set check-in and check-out dates (navigate months if needed)
Click Search and open the top hotel

opportunities.name: Family call email with city time and weather
opportunities.description: For a city and relative, look up local time on timeanddate and the 10-day forecast on Weather.com, then compose a 'Call with <person>' draft email with time and forecast.
steps: Search the city on timeanddate and open the result to read local time and offset
Search the city on Weather.com and open the 10 Day forecast
Open new message, set To to family@example.com
Type body with local time, offset, forecast
